# ref-serve test fixtures

- `capture/`: Engine outputs captured once on a GPU host (see its README). These predate the production-serving setup (RFC-0015 SRV-6, 2026-11-09): they were recorded on an L40S using the SASH workloads' FP8-at-load files and the `LLM` class. Tests use them only to exercise the outputs builder and release protocol; the S1 and S2 captures in `docs/runbooks/hf-jobs.md` (§Production serving) supersede them.
- `resolved-default.txt`: A shape fixture representing the engine's resolved-configuration log line, matching the field list of vLLM v0.32.0 `VllmConfig.__str__` ([vllm/config/vllm.py L2703 to L2738](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/v0.32.0/vllm/config/vllm.py#L2703-L2738)) with placeholder values so the RFC-0015 SRV-3 comparison can run on CPU. It is not a real dump of the engine's defaults; once the first real capture's `resolved_config` line (from `commands.jsonl`) replaces it, tests will compare each run's line against that stored default.
